headline: GTA 6 countdown: 5 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 5 Days Left | Grassrivers + Leonida Keys | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 5 days until GTA 6. The map also has Grassrivers and the Leonida Keys, inspired by the Everglades and the Florida Keys. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: Fair warning: the swamp will probably be faster than your car.
